faq.title: KimiFleet software FAQ
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about modernizing your rental operations.
faq.q1: How does the QR digital signature work?
faq.a1: Clients sign directly on their own device after scanning a QR code, and the signature is stored with your rental record — no more paper contracts or lost signatures.
faq.a3: Absolutely. KimiFleet is built for multi-branch agencies with centralized administration.
faq.q4: How secure is our agency data?
faq.a4: Each agency's data is isolated from other accounts by our multi-tenant architecture, and all traffic to and from KimiFleet is protected with HTTPS.
faq.q5: Can I migrate from my current spreadsheets?
faq.a5: Yes. You can add your vehicles, clients, and rental history directly in the dashboard in just a few minutes — no need to keep working from spreadsheets.
faq.a6: Our financial module allows you to record partial and full payments, syncing them directly with your rental records and invoices.
faq.q7: Is there a mobile app for my team?
faq.a7: Yes. Our mobile app lets your staff manage rentals, vehicles, clients, and invoices from their phone, with push notifications for fleet alerts and rental events.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How KimiFleet collects, uses, and protects your personal data.
privacy.data_collected_desc: We collect information you provide when creating an account: full name, email address, phone number, and business details. We also collect authentication tokens, device identifiers, and push notification tokens to deliver our service.
privacy.how_we_use_desc: Your data is used solely to operate the KimiFleet platform — to authenticate your account, manage your fleet and rental records, send operational notifications, and provide customer support. We do not sell your data to third parties.
privacy.data_security_desc: We use multi-tenant architecture to ensure your business data is fully isolated from other accounts. All data is encrypted in transit (TLS). Access is restricted to authorized personnel only.
privacy.notifications_desc: With your consent, we send push notifications for rental events, fleet alerts, and platform updates through our mobile app. You can disable notifications at any time from your device settings.
privacy.retention_desc: We retain your data for as long as your account is active. Upon account deletion, your personal data is removed within 30 days. Rental records may be retained for legal compliance purposes as required by applicable law.
privacy.contact_desc: If you have questions about this privacy policy or wish to request access to or deletion of your personal data, contact us at the address below.
